sourceNotes.rawContent:
A dreamy pastel-toned hamper made for your favourite person — perfect for Friendship Day, birthdays, or just to say "you are my best friend." Comes with cute quote cards and a mix of everyday jewellery pieces she can actually wear on repeat.
What's Inside:
- Morchadi Jewels Pearl Beaded Chain Necklace
- Morchadi Jewels Stud Earrings Set (6 Pairs – Gold & Silver Tone)
- Peach & Pearl Beaded Flower Charm Bracelet
- Gold-Tone Twisted Ring
- Satin Scrunchie – Peach
- Orange Acrylic Flower Hair Claw Clip
-
Why She'll Love It:
- A complete jewellery set — necklace, 6 earring pairs, bracelet & ring in one box
- Soft, wearable everyday pieces in a cohesive pastel palette
- Comes with cute friendship-themed quote cards, ready to gift
- Perfect for Friendship Day, birthdays, or a "thinking of you" surprise
Note: Cash on Delivery (COD) is not available for this hamper. Prepaid orders only.
